description: This dataset represents order-picking operations in a footwear-manufacturing warehouse in Sherbrooke, Quebec. École de technologie supérieure researchers extracted warehouse-management-system information and organised storage locations, aisles, depots, product classifications, customer orders and picking waves. Alternative random, class-based, dedicated and hybrid storage configurations support comparisons. Mendeley version 1 lists twenty-one files, including CSV tables, a DWG layout, SVG drawings and a processing notebook, free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is one warehouse; a calendar observation interval was not established. Anonymisation and randomisation preserve operating patterns but limit reconstruction of actual individual operators or exact commercial history. Modellers could test picker-routing, batching and storage policies or autonomous vehicle navigation in warehouse simulations. platform-siemens-plant-simulation is a related material-flow environment, without a verified import path. This is a reusable operational benchmark despite its single-site origin. No order records, CAD files or notebook body were downloaded, and no picking algorithm was run.
